mapper.select: SELECT id as id, deposit_item_id as deposit_item_id, total_principal as total_principal, total_interest as total_interest, installments as installments, monthly_day as monthly_day, start_date as start_date, payment_account_id as payment_account_id, created_at as created_at, user_id as user_id FROM installment_plans WHERE deposit_item_id = #{depositItemId}
SELECT id FROM installment_plans WHERE deposit_item_id = #{depositItemId}
SELECT deposit_item_id FROM installment_plans WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO installment_plans (id, deposit_item_id, total_principal, total_interest, installments, monthly_day, start_date, payment_account_id, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{depositItemId}, #{totalPrincipal}, #{totalInterest}, #{installments}, #{monthlyDay}, #{startDate}, #{paymentAccountId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, deposit_item_id, total_principal, total_interest, installments, monthly_day, start_date, payment_account_id FROM installment_plans
SELECT period, due_date, status, paid_at FROM installment_bills WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY period
SELECT period, due_date, paid_at FROM installment_bills WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'paid'

SELECT id as id, plan_id as plan_id, period as period, due_date as due_date, principal as principal, interest as interest, total as total, status as status, paid_at as paid_at, created_at as created_at, user_id as user_id FROM installment_bills WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY period
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO installment_bills (id, plan_id, period, due_date, principal, interest, total, status, paid_at, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{planId}, #{period}, #{dueDate}, #{principal}, #{interest}, #{total}, #{status}, #{paidAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.plan_id, b.period, b.total, b.status, p.payment_account_id, p.deposit_item_id, d.name AS item_name FROM installment_bills b JOIN installment_plans p ON b.plan_id = p.id JOIN deposit_items d ON p.deposit_item_id = d.id WHERE b.id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE installment_bills SET status = 'paid', paid_at = #{paidAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT b.id as bill_id, b.plan_id as plan_id, b.period as period, b.total as bill_total, p.payment_account_id as payment_account_id, p.deposit_item_id as deposit_item_id, d.name as item_name FROM installment_bills b JOIN installment_plans p ON b.plan_id = p.id JOIN deposit_items d ON p.deposit_item_id = d.id WHERE b.status = 'pending' AND b.due_date <= #{today}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS remaining FROM installment_bills WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND status = 'pending'
